title: Classic Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and onion sauce, finished with fresh coriander and crusty bread.
steps: Soften the onions, chilli, garlic and coriander stalks in oil, then stir in the tomatoes and sugar and simmer 8-10 minutes until thick.
Make 4 dips in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook over low heat 6-8 minutes.
Scatter with coriander leaves and serve with crusty bread.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food shakshuka

notes: A dinner-for-breakfast classic — good on a night you want something warm and quick.
